name: floating-button
description: A persistent bottom-of-screen CTA banner with optional hide-on-scroll behavior when a target element enters the viewport.

label.title: Button label
label.description: Text displayed inside the floating action button.

href.title: Button URL
href.description: Link destination opened when the floating button is clicked.

external.title: Open in new tab
external.description: When true, the button opens the link in a new browser tab with safe rel attributes.

iconLeft.title: Icon on the left
iconLeft.description: FontAwesome icon class applied before the button label.

iconRight.title: Icon on the right
iconRight.description: FontAwesome icon class applied after the button label.

autoHide.title: Enable auto-hide
autoHide.description: When true, the floating button hides automatically when the target element becomes visible.

targetButtonId.title: Target element selector
targetButtonId.description: ID or CSS selector of the page element that hides the floating button when it enters view.

ariaLabel.title: ARIA label
ariaLabel.description: Accessible label for the floating action button.
